system.description:
Until the end of your turn you gain Mana Razor granting your basic melee attacks an additional 30ft range. Augmenting melee attacks with this ability makes them into ranged attacks. If using a Two-Handed melee weapon with Mana Razor, gain an additional 45ft range instead.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 mana to have this also affect basic ranged attacks and to remove the Quick keyword from it.

You use your Encounter Start action to give yourself Mana Shield, which gives you Temporary HP equal to your Toughness + 3 or Focus + 3 (whichever is higher). 

Wearing armor reduces this to 2/3rd, 1/3rd or 0 if wearing Light, Medium or Heavy Armor respectively. While Mana Shield is active, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity from casting Spells from enemies that are Challenged by you.

Until the end of the encounter, at the start of your turn you may spend 1 mana to restore your Mana Shield to its maximum value. (With similarly reduced values for wearing armor)

If you did not use this as an encounter start, you may also spend 1 AP and 1 Mana to activate this.
You can assess the approximate mana percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable mana bar for the unit).

Benefit 1

You may use Mana Sight.

Benefit 2

One of your eyes becomes an Life Perception Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

Benefit 3

When making an attack with the Mystic Eye keyword that use the Life Perception eye, you ignore 1 point of guard.

system.description:
You extend your Threads of Light and make an unarmed light attack against a target within range. On damage, you may pull yourself towards the target and sidestep to the nearest square within 5ft of them.

You may also use this on ally. If you do, this always hits and deals no damage. It still gives you a stack of Harmony.

You wrap your Threads of Light around the chosen ally and channel your Harmony into them.

You may spend up to 5 stacks of Harmony and 1 mana per stack you consume to heal an ally within range for 3+Focus for each stack.
system.requirement: Must have at least 1 stack of Harmony.

system.description:
You mark a single enemy, inflicting Mark of Justice on them. A marked enemy’s movement speed is reduced to 20ft. Abilities that allow for movement cannot move the target for more than 20ft per use. Secret Arts and Esoteric Arts are not affected by this. You can only have a single enemy marked by this at the same time. It lasts until the end of the encounter. Does not work on vehicles.

A marked target may spend 1 mana per AP/RP of the action (with a minimum of 1 mana even for 0 AP abilities) to temporarily ignore the restricting effect for a movement action.

Benefit 1

Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient.

Benefit 2

You gain +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation or a relevant Expert Knowledge skill (By DM approval). You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

Benefit 3

You can use Discipline.

Your spells with the Gravity keyword deal extra damage to the target based on its size. They deal an additional 1 damage to large creatures and an additional 3 to Huge creatures.

Benefit 2

You may use Gravity Crush.

You sidestep up to 10ft towards the target and make a melee Heavy attack against them. 

On damage, if your power is equal or higher than the target's, they are knocked Prone.
You jump to a target within range and may make a Light attack against them. All enemies within 5ft of the target must make a save or become Unbalanced.

You gain proficiency in 1 common and 1 specialized weapon

Benefit 2

You gain +5 skill points to spend in Art. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.

system.description:
You physically touch up to five willing people, granting them Mind Connection—creating a mind link through you.  While linked, each creature can speak through telepathy to all other creatures linked to the same caster.  Mind Connection has unlimited duration but also reduces your maximum mana by 1, this effect lasts until you cancel Mind Connection.  Mind Connection has a maximum range of 500 ft—breaking this range doesn’t cancel the spell but interrupts the signal until within range again.

While Mind Connection lasts, you may spend 1 AP to transfer view through the eyes of one of the people connected with the mind link.

You may ask the GM for the rough best course of action during an encounter based on the information you have. The GM should answer truthfully, but does not need to go in depth. (For example: Retreat, kill the grunts, focus the boss, use magic attacks etc).
You start with the Miner class unlocked and at level 1.

You create an immobile sphere of protection in a 5ft radius that prevents all entry into and out of it. The Shield has health points equal to 20 + Toughness x 8. Attacks and Magical Effects cannot be casted out of or into the Sanctuary, which functions as line-of-sight blocking for the purposes of abilities. Sanctuary lasts until the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep (1 Mana). The Spell also ends when the Shield’s health points are reduced to zero.

You may take the Dodge action. If the attack is successfully avoided, the attack is then made against an enemy within 5ft of you and using the same accuracy roll. This enemy must be different from the one making the attack. The new target may react to this attack as normal.

Does not work against Secret Art or Esoteric Art level attacks.
system.requirement: You are the target of an attack and have a different enemy within 5ft of you.

You gain proficiency in the Aetherie Sensory Station.

Benefit 2

You may use Mind Connection.

system.description:
A mist rolls out from around you, trapping those caught in it in a misty vale in which travelers are doomed to die. All in the mist must make a save against your Potency when they try to escape it. If they fail their save when they attempt to move out, you may finish the remaining movement for them as long as they end within your mist. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

The mist also blocks Line of Sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the mist can only see up to 5ft into or out of mist.

The mist is a 15ft radius around yourself, but if flying it does not go below you. You may choose to exclude allies from the trapping effect. If you do, the upkeep mana cost and initial mana cost is increased by 1.

Upkeep: 1 AP

Until the start of your next turn, the ground 5ft around you becomes like burning ground.

Any enemy willingly leaving or moving through this area other than entering it becomes Burning X, where X is your Focus x 3.

The domain burns away other friendly damage aura effects while in effect. Effects that would normally trigger upon ending the turn in it (such as Poison Spore) don't trigger if someone ends their turn in the Molten Domain.

You make a Heavy attack against the target. For every 10ft moved during your last action this turn, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10 damage. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this.
You attack the target with the pommel or crossguard making a Heavy Attack against the target.
system.requirement: Longsword, Heavy Blades and Bludgeoning weapons only.

You gain proficiency in Polearms, Lances, Light armor, Shields and one other common weapon group of your choice.

Benefit 2

You gain 5 skill points in Riding. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

Benefit 3

Benefit 4

If you have mastered cavalier, your mount can withstand one lethal blow. If your mount would be reduced to 0 HP or below by an attack, it instead is reduced to 1 HP. Only works once per encounter.

system.description:
You move a puppet piece you can see that's under your control. The way it moves depends on the type of piece. When a piece moves, it's a Sidestep.

Pawn: Moves up to 2 squares orthogonally or 1 square diagonally in a straight line.

Knight: Moves 1 square orthogonally, then 1 square diagonal in the same direction it moved in orthogonally (like a knight in chess). Can pass through allies and enemies.

Bishop: Moves up to 8 squares diagonally in a straight line. 

Rook: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally in a straight line.

Queen: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally or diagonally in a straight line.

Except for the Knight, chess pieces cannot move through allies and stop their movement when they hit an object or creature. If this happens, it makes a Heavy attack that deals Physical(Bludgeoning) damage against that target with your stats. A knight that makes an attack and does not kill the target remains in its original spot.

On damage, a piece is promoted into a higher rank (Pawn -> Bishop/Knight -> Rook -> Queen). A queen cannot promote.

On Killing Blow, a piece occupies the square of the thing it attacked.

You may move up to your Speed + up to 15ft per mana spent on this ability. Any unspent movement is lost afterwards.

If you spend more than 1 Mana on this ability, it loses the Stealth keyword.

You create a wall 4ft high, 1ft thick and up to 20ft long that serves as low cover. Anybody attempting to get over the wall treats it as difficult terrain. Walls must be placed on solid ground and cannot be stacked on top of eachother.

Each 5ft of wall has 60 HP and dissolves if it reaches 0. It otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter.

You may spend 1 RP instead of 2 AP on this ability instead.

You deliver the first motion, a graceful strike that awakens awareness in both you and your foe and you make a Light attack against the target. On hit, you gain a Harmony stack (In addition to the one you might get if this deals damage.)

Combo: When used after entering Luminous Form Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.
You may make a Heavy Attack against two different targets. Overcharge: You may spend X extra mana to attack 2 + X targets instead.

You temporarily empower your eyes. While active, you gain 360 degree vision and automatically detect all enemies within a 30ft radius of you that are not behind at least 1ft of full cover. In addition, you can see the approximate HP and Mana percentage of all enemies in this range. This lasts for 5 minutes or until you turn it off.

Benefit 1

At the start of your turn you may pay upkeep 1 mana for each Regrowth you have on an ally. If you do, you may extend its duration by 1 turn. You can choose this upkeep separately for each Regrowth.

Benefit 2

You may use Regrowth.

You shoot out a vine that wraps around the target and make a Light Attack against the target that only deals 1 Earth damage. On damage, the target becomes Rooted until the start of your next turn or until they spend 2 AP to remove the root with a slashing or fire based attack.

Against Grunts, this attack costs 0 Mana and gains Sure Hit.

You begin singing a supportive song.

Once per round per ally, when an ally fails to meet the base evasion with an attack, you may spend 2 Mana to add that ally’s focus bonus for that attack.

Upkeep: 1 AP

Benefit 1

You gain 60ft darkvision, allowing you to see perfectly in the dark even without a source of light. If you already have darkvision, the range of it improves by 60ft.

For your next movement action, you may treat the surface you’re walking on as horizontal ground, allowing you to walk over water or up walls.

Benefit 2

system.requirement: Can only be used at the moment an enemy declares a movement.

system.description:
You give your ally’s attack Lock On, but the damage is minimized (and cannot be maximized) and it loses Full Pierce, Block Crush and any on hit or on damage effects. If used after a target has already dodged, they may Block against that attack for free.

Can be used when an ally misses an ability to make it not count as a miss for your Secret Art: Full Combo (but the attack does not actually gain Lock On)
system.requirement: An ally within your Idol Song’s range misses a basic attack.

system.description: You throw a bottle of oil on the ground within range, creating a 15x15 area of slippery oil. If the target contacts the oil at any point of movement (even the start or end) and they moved more than 5ft in a single movement action, they immediately fall prone. The slick lasts until the start of your next turn.

Benefit 1

While you are at 1 HP or higher, damage (including true damage) you take during your own turn cannot reduce you below 1 HP.

Benefit 2

When you roll a 1 on a skill check, something unexpected may happen (GM's discretion). This is usually bad, but it could also turn out to be a blessing in disguise.

All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their accuracy. This bonus is doubled on Precise attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP
You order one willing allied unit to retreat, moving up to their Speed. All movement must be made towards you, and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

You can gather Tier 2 mining outcrops.

Benefit 2

You are an expert and tying knots. Using rope, you can secure yourself to objects and safely rappel down to investigate down cliffsides.

system.description:
You create 3 illusionary copies of yourself within 10ft of yourself or your Bunshin clone. These copies can take actions similar to your Bunshin Tai no Jutsu, but each of them may also act with its own 2 AP from the start of your next turn.

Each clone has 1 HP and upon taking any damage, they vanish. You may use RP for these clones as normal.

Upkeep: 2 AP

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, inflicts the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.

If the target is already suffering from Toxic, instead immediately trigger the damage effect from it.
system.requirement: Must be made with a melee weapon or with a Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

system.description:
While on adventure, you get a 5% discount from NPC vendors, stacking with Bulk Orders if applicable, and can sell items for 10% more.

You may use an IP to give this discount effect to yourself and up to 9 other characters for that Interlude phase, for a total of a 800c discount.
You may add 1d10 crafting points to the item. The item starts in the Broken condition. Cannot be used for Alchemy crafting.

You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. For every point of Power you have over the target, you deal 2 additional damage.

Combo: If used after Meteor Cleave, the AP cost is reduced by 1.

When you take the Heal Injury, Appraise or Mentor IP actions, you may do the same action again for an EP.

In addition, if you take the Rest interlude action you may give the benefit to a different character instead. This does not stack with any Rest bonuses they may have already.

Benefit 1

When you roll a critical hit while making a Heavy attack with a Two-Handed weapon you may use Aftershock even if the attack didn’t miss. This use doesn’t count against the normal use limit of it and this effect still applies even if the critical hit was blocked or otherwise defended against.

system.description: You count as mounted for the purposes of abilities that require you to be mounted. This does not let you be a mount to other creatures.

Select a target within range. Until the end of your turn, while the target has one of your allies within 5ft of it, you gain Pack Tactics, which gives a +2 bonus on accuracy checks for melee attacks against that target.

You inject a willing ally with some helpful drugs to grant them temporary HP until the start of your next turn equal to your Focus x X. 

The target cannot benefit from this ability again until the end of your next turn.
You prepare to roll from an incoming attack. Your next Dodge action before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP. If you successfully avoid an attack with this Dodge action, you may Sidestep 5ft.

You enter a stance in which you use your tail for extra balance. When you would be knocked back or prone, you may end this stance to negate the effect. This stance then ends.

Otherwise, the stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

You may use AP or RP for this ability.

You may remove a single negative non-physical effect from yourself (ie, fears, charms but not things such as bleed). If you are afflicted with more than 1 negative effect that is a valid target, you may choose which one you remove.

Roll your Heavy Weapon Damage, but add your Focus instead of Power to the roll and treat that as your Block against the attack targeting you. If Parry reduces the damage to 0, you regain 1 RP (cannot go higher than your max RP). On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0.

When using Parry against an attack, that attack cannot land a critical hit against you.
system.requirement: Target of a melee attack, wielding a One-Handed melee weapon.

system.description:
You place a past self token at your current position that lasts until the end of the encounter. Your past self tokens are used for other abilities and cannot be attacked normally.

When you make a weapon attack, you may have the attack come from a past self token. After a past self token attacks, it becomes targetable by attacks and effects for 1 round as if you were in that position though you cannot be hit more than once by the same attack because of this.

Your past selves cannot be moved, willingly or forcefully.

Benefit 1

You may use Past Self.

Benefit 2

Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and may use it multiple times.
system.benefits:

Benefit 2

Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and may use it multiple times.

You reach into your pocket and pull out a handful of ground chili pepper that you throw in front of you in a 15ft cube. Inflicts all targets with Pepper Spray, causing Blinded 4 and the inability to smell.  The target or an ally of the target within 5ft can spend 1 AP to wipe it off. Otherwise the effect ends at the end of the target’s next turn.

You may spend 1 RP and 1 additional mana instead of paying the AP cost.

When given enough preparation time and enough knowledge about the subject, you are able to perfectly impersonate another person (GM’s discretion on what is ‘enough’). Automatically fails if the target has cover when this ability finishes.

If the next Spell you cast applies a buff or debuff, the duration of this buff or debuff is extended by 1 turn. If the Spell allows for a save, the target may make another save after the original effect is over to resist the duration extension.

You create a 5x5, 20ft high pillar below someone. The target may spend 1 RP to step out of the way.

Each block of the pillar has HP equal to 20+Focus and the entire pillar collapses if one block is removed from it.

You make a Light attack against the target with your weapon. On damage, if there is a wall or similar object directly behind the target, they become pinned against it. A pinned target is considered Rooted until they spend 2 AP to remove the arrow pinning them.

You make a Light Attack with a pistol in your hand. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

This attack benefits from alloys and material bonuses on your pistol (but not from any on your unarmed strike).

You gain controlled Flight and Hover up to your speed.  This ability ends at the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep 3 Mana, if you choose to not pay upkeep, you cannot use Pixie Flight until the start of your next turn.

You choose to spend either 1 minute or 1 hour to place an undetermined trap in an area. You may only have 2 traps placed at a time in this way.

When an enemy comes within 20ft of you, you may spend 0 RP to determine the effects of a trap and trigger it. If you spent 1 minute, you may choose a Simple Trap. If you spent 1 hour, you may choose either a Simple Trap or a Complex Trap.

Log Swing (Simple): The target takes Light bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 20ft.

Snare (Simple): You place up to 3 snare traps, each within 20ft of each other. When triggered, the target’s movement is interrupted and they fall prone.

Net (Complex): The target is caught in a net and raised up into the air. It remains rooted there until the net is destroyed by dealing 15 damage, after which the target falls prone on the ground below it.

A target may spend AP equal to the AP cost of the talisman (before reductions) to remove the talisman from themselves.

After placing it, until the end of the encounter or for the next 5 minutes, you may spend 0 RP to instantly trigger the effect of the talisman. You cannot trigger it anymore once a talisman has been removed or is in the process of being removed and a removed talisman loses its power entirely. Choose a target base item (no modifications) and an amount of that item. Determine the price of the total items and set it as the Procurement Target goal.

Every time you gain an IP, you gain 500 points towards the Procurement goal. You may also spend an IP to add another 500 points towards the goal.

AoE attacks that deal Holy damage remove a number of zombies equal to the damage taken. The zombie group has a focus and power of 3 + 1 for every 3 zombies, rounded down. Because they are undead, they are immune to all mind-affecting effects.

You create a blood tether to all enemies within range, causing them to be Slowed. The tether lasts until the start of your next turn or until they move out of the range of this ability.

At the start of your next turn, the tethers explode, dealing Heavy damage to all tethered enemies as it sucks the life energy from them. For every enemy dealt damage with this ability, you recover 1 Mana or 5 HP (your choice). If an enemy dies while under the effect of the tether but before it explodes, you also gain this regeneration effect.

You focus on a single enemy and maintain a constant position from them. Whenever the target moves, you may move the same amount as they did (up to your movement speed) away from them for 0 RP. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target, but does provoke from other enemies.

 Every time this happens, you may make a Light attack against the target with a ranged weapon. If the target spends multiple AP on a single movement action, you may make an amount of Light attacks equal to the AP they spent.

Lasts until the start of your next turn or until you can no longer see the target.
You may move all your pieces as if you used Move Piece on them.

You make a Heavy attack that deals Holy damage against the target. If your target’s HP is lower than the max damage your attack would deal, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

This calculation only involves your base damage (Base weapon damage + the power). Any other effects added to the damage such as Heavy Blade's bonus damage, Anathema on target etc do not affect the calculation and aren't maximized.

An enemy reduced to 0 HP or lower with this ability is immediately killed.
system.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

system.description:
Until the start of your next turn, you gain Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types, but you only deal half damage.

You gain 2 AP.

Must be used as the first action in your turn.
You gain 4 AP. Your AP recovery is lowered by 3 until the end of your next turn.

You Jump up to the target, not provoking any attacks of opportunity, and make a Heavy Attack against it. On damage, the target plummets to the ground taking falling damage as normal. Overcharge: You may spend additional AP on this ability to increase the range by 60ft for every extra AP spent. If this increases the AP cost to more than what you currently have, it gains the Setup keyword.
system.requirement: Target must be airborne, polearm only.

system.description: You challenge all enemies in range until the start of your next turn. Any time you would be allowed to make an Attack of Opportunity, your Soulmate may make it instead. They may Sidestep up to their speed before making each Attack of Opportunity.

You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all enemies in range that are touching the ground. On damage, they fall prone.

You also make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all magically created walls and similar inanimate objects created by magic. You deal 10x damage against those targets.

You reduce the cost of your next non-healing keyword action by 2 mana. This cannot reduce the mana cost below 0.

Also resets your Circuits, allowing abilities with the Circuit keyword to be used for their reduced mana cost once more.

You make two Light Attacks against the same target. On damage of this attack, you may repeat this attack for 0 AP.

Killing Blow: You may move up to twice your speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

You send out a wave of energy that disrupts spirit circuits that cancels all temporary magic effects in range. All non-permanent effects within range that are created by an ability with the Spell or Enchantment keyword are affected. Spells that do not have a time limit listed or create a permanent effect such as a Geomancer's fissure are not affected.

Bounded Fields and Secret Arts cannot be removed by this ability.

In addition, artifices cannot be used by anyone except you until the end of your next turn.

name: Secret Art: Everything, Everywhere, All At Once

system.description:
You make a Heavy Attack against the enemy. 

You may then repeat this attack from each of your past selves and may target the same enemy multiple times.

You may make 4 Heavy Attacks against the target. Afterwards, the weapon used for this ability cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.

If an enemy reacts to this ability with a Dodge or Block type reaction, that reaction is valid for all 4 attacks.

You choose a target and pick between basic actions or abilities. 

Until the start of your next turn, any time the target does the chosen action, they take Full Pierce damage equal to your Focus per AP spent on it.

Your allies gain +4 Song bonus to their damage rolls. This is doubled on Heavy attacks.

If an ally misses an attack, this bonus is reduced to +1.

Upkeep: 1 AP

Make a Heavy attack against the target. Unless your accuracy roll is a 1, your roll is treated as if you rolled a 20 and it gains Sure Hit. 

It is treated as a critical hit even though it's Sure Hit, unless the target blocks.

You create a space-time anomaly that freezes time itself in a local area for a short while, affecting all but the strong-willed.  All non-heroic units in range cannot take any actions until the end of their next turn.
You subvert fate and a bad end, twisting reality into its most fortunate outcome.  When a target ally rolls a 1, you can instead change it to a 20.

You may make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may spend 1 RP to avoid the attack. If they do, you may Sidestep them up to 20ft in a direction of your choice and then trigger a Place Trap effect, provided you have at least one set up.

This trap effect does not count towards your per encounter limitation. You may not Sidestep an enemy into a hazard (such as off a cliff or into fire) apart from your trap, unless the target has nowhere else to go.

Alternatively, you may choose to move an enemy into a Bear Trap you set up within the 20ft movement instead of a Place Trap effect. You can only choose one of these two options, not both.
You take the Block action against the triggering attack. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Disarmed until the start of their next turn.
system.requirement: You are attacked by a Melee attack.

system.description:
You reduce your HP to 1 and make a Heavy attack against the target. You gain a bonus to the damage roll of this attack equal to the amount of HP you lost through this ability.

If this attack fails to meet the base evasion of the target, the HP you lost is refunded. It still counts as your one secret art use of the fight regardless.

You lose HP until your HP reaches 1. Target ally within range recovers that much HP. Any HP that exceeds the target’s max HP becomes temporary HP.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.
The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to their missing HP.

You conjure a statically charged field around you, applying Static X where X equals your Focus x 3 to all enemies within 30ft of you. Enemies already afflicted by Static immediately take damage equal to 3 + half the static value. While within your Lightning Field, the Static on enemies is not removed at the end of their turn.

This field lasts until the end of your next turn.

Upkeep: You may pay 1 Mana at the start of your turn to repeat the initial effect and extend the duration of the field by 1 turn.

You infuse yourself with Lightning and gain Lightning Release until the end of the encounter, allowing you to deal Lightning damage with your unarmed attacks and immediately enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance. While this lasts, you also gain the following benefits: 

  • Your movement speed is doubled.
  • You can make an additional attack when you use Double Punch. 
  • When making an unarmed attack, your critical threshold is lowered by 1 (19-20 base). Whenever you hit with a critical hit with an unarmed attack that deals Lightning damage, the attack arcs to a different enemy within 20ft of the original target. This attack uses the same attack roll and damage, but cannot arc again.

If you ever leave the Lightning Stance, you lose the benefit of this.

You mark a 30x30ft area and begin summoning a meteor to strike it at the start of your next turn. Those in the area when it lands take Heavy Fire Damage. 

Overcharge: You may spend extra AP on this ability to increase the damage and size of it. For every extra 2 AP spent on it, the size increases by 5ft and the damage increases by your Power. If the Overcharge increases the AP cost to above 4, this ability gains the Setup keyword. You mark the area of this ability when you have finished spending all AP on it and not before. The maximum AP you can spend on this ability is 16 AP.

You project a defensive aura up to 15ft around you, granting all allies (excluding yourself) the Bulwark buff. While under the effects of Bulwark, allies take 3 less damage.

While projecting this aura, you may spend 0 RP to sidestep up to your movement. After you do so, you may not do so again until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

You fill your target with mycelium from your spore symbiote, removing the Downed state from them and preventing them from entering the downed State while this effect lasts. Removing Spore Symbiote from the target cancels this effect. This effect ends at the start of your next turn unless you spend 1 mana to continue the effect.  When paying upkeep, if the target is below 0 HP, heal the target for your power + 3.

This effect ends if the target’s HP is reduced to negative their maximum HP amount.

You can use 1 RP instead of 2 AP to use this ability.
system.requirement: Must be used on your Spore Symbiote target that is in the Downed state.

system.description:
You channel your power into your mount, allowing it to unleash a devastating attack based on what type of mount it is.

Pegasus: Bellerophon: You Sidestep towards a target within 60ft and make a Heavy attack against it. This attack has Lock-on and costs 1 RP and 2 Mana

Wyvern: Reginliev: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a 5ft wide line up to a point within 60ft. You also make a Heavy attack against all enemies within 10ft of the selected point, though enemies can also take an attack from this ability once. This attack costs 2 AP and 2 Mana.

Dragonfly: Darting Mirage: You move at incredible speed and create several illusionary afterimages in your wake. Until the start of your next turn, every attack against you or your mount that is not a critical hit or does not have the Sure Hit keyword  automatically misses. This is an Illusion effect. This ability costs 0 AP and 4 Mana.

All these attacks are made with your mount’s stats instead of your own.
system.requirement: Must be mounted on a mount mentioned in the description.

system.description: Until the end of the encounter, it is considered night for all your abilities and items that are affected by it.
Reduces the mana cost of your next Spell cast this turn by 3. You cannot gain mana from this.

You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a line and move through them. You keep moving through enemies until you reach an empty spot you can stand in. If there is no valid end position due to an ally occupying the spot or terrain (such as a wall) being in the way, you cannot use this ability.

You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, on the next turn, you may repeat this attack against the same target using the same accuracy check as the initial attack. You may continue to repeat this attack on subsequent turns until you spend a turn not using this move or if the attack fails to deal damage.
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Fire Damage. This attack gains Lock On against a target that has the Burning condition that you inflicted on it.

You create a rapid spinning hurricane with a 15x15 size and 50ft in height in the target location. All creatures caught in the hurricane immediately take Wind Light Damage and are pushed out of the Hurricane. Every creature that enters the hurricane immediately takes Wind Light Damage and must succeed at a save against your Potency or be pushed back 20ft. Leaving the hurricane does no damage and requires no save. Upkeep: You must spend 1 Mana and 2 AP at the start of each turn or the spell ends. When you pay this Upkeep, you may move the hurricane up to 20ft. Any creature that comes into contact with the hurricane during this move takes damage and must make a save as if they had entered it.

You rewind time to before your last action. All results based on your last action are reversed- All HP, Mana, AP and RP are returned to how they were. The ability you used in that action is no longer considered used, but this ability is.
system.requirement: Can only be used on your turn.

name: Secret Art: Ride of the Valkyrie

system.description:
You Sidestep up to your speed and can move through enemies for this movement. You and every ally you pass through are healed for 11 + (Power x 2).

This movement must always be in a straight line, regardless of your mount type.

You deal 17 true damage to the target. If this damage lowers the target’s HP to 0 or lower, they immediately die.
If the target of this attack is a non-heroic unit, they instantly die regardless of their remaining HP.

You make a Heavy Attack against the target using a Blacksmith’s Hammer. If the target chooses to Block the attack, they gain 100 damage reduction against it. If they do, choose one equipped non-divine arms weapon in their hand that has equal or less crafted enhancements than your hammer and destroy that item, giving it the Broken condition.
system.requirement: Attack must be made with a Blacksmith's Hammer.

system.description: You and your allies in range gain Shield Wall, which reduces the damage they take from the triggering attack by 75.
system.requirement: Usable when you are the target of an ability that affects an area, using a shield.

system.description:
You and up to 3 other allies within range gain 3 AP they must spend immediately. On their next turn, they regain 1 less AP.

These AP may not be spent on Setup abilities and normal once per turn ability limitations apply.

name: Secret Art: Shot From The Blue

system.description:
You recall hiring a sniper specifically for a situation like this. 

The sniper mercenary, off screen, takes a single shot at the target before retreating. You grant the signal, and the sniper fires, dealing heavy damage with full pierce and sure hit to the target. This shot uses the stats from the Sniper NPC, attacking with +6 Accuracy (if relevant) and dealing 4d6+10 damage.

Shot From The Blue does not gain Sure Hit and Full Pierce against targets with Instinct.

If the target is a grunt, kill them instantly.
system.requirement: Target is outdoors or reasonably visible from outdoors. Costs 500 Clim to use.

system.description:
You drain the surrounding area of energy and form a skeletal champion until the end of the encounter. (Stats can be found in the Monster page)

This champion takes 2 of your summon limit. Any zombies you had active when you summoned this are instead converted into temporary HP for the champion at a rate of 5 HP per zombie.

The champion acts after you on the initiative, but cannot take AP actions on the turn it is summoned.

Upkeep: 2 AP

Overcharge: You may spend 5 mana to give your summon the ability to act on the turn it is summoned.

Until the end of the encounter, you enchant your weapon with every single element. When using Elemental Strike or Elemental Sweep, you may choose which effect you want regardless of the damage type your attack deals. When you deal damage, you apply the damage type that would deal the most damage.

In addition, your weapon gains a +1 Power bonus until the end of the encounter. If it already had a +1 Power bonus through an enchantment, this bonus is instead increased to +2.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

You stigmatize the targets spirit, they are inflicted with Spirit Stigma until the start of your next turn. A target with Spirit Stigma counts as a willing ally for your Eremancer abilities and damaging them fulfills the Malevolent  Phantasm requirement.

Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends a proxy of themselves to fight for you.  The Eidolon called and the costs are dependent on your attunement.  Lasts up to 5 minutes.  You must pay the upkeep cost under the Eidolon’s Summon Skill or the Eidolon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned, except for RP actions.

Overcharge: You may spend 5 mana to give your summon the ability to act on the turn it is summoned.

You channel all masteries of the elements and fire a barrage of elemental bolts at the target.

You make 7 light attacks, doing Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning and Earth damage respectively.

Overcharge: You may spend one more mana to make additional Light attacks, one that does Holy damage and one that does Dark damage.

All allies within range may sidestep up to their movement speed.

You may Sidestep all enemies within range up to their movement speed.

After all targets have moved, everyone that was originally in range of this ability immediately gains 2 AP they must spend on attacks against other creatures if possible.

You greatly increase the size and weight of your weapons, then slam them down in a direction. You make a melee Heavy attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to the range. On damage, a target is knocked prone.

 

After the initial hit, a shockwave follows. You make another Heavy attack against any enemy still in the original line’s range. This second attack has the Sure Hit and Full Pierce qualities against a prone target.
system.requirement: Must be wielding two Two-Handed melee weapons.

system.description:
You touch the ground, transmuting a Proto Armatae of your own design.  The Proto Armatae lifts you up and immediately encases you into its cockpit.   The Proto Armatae is 15ft tall and is a large creature that occupies a 15ftx15ft space.  All creatures and moveable objects surrounding the Proto Armatae are pushed back away from its zone of control in a burst of steam.  The Armatae also gains a temporary shield with 20 HP that disappears at the start of your next turn.

You must use your own actions to cause the Proto Armatae to move and attack.  You can eject from a transmutation hatch on the top at the center of the Proto Armatae for 1 AP, in which the Proto Armatae stops functioning.  When you re-enter you must close the hatch for 1 AP before the Proto Armatae functions again. 

The Proto Armatae has health equal to 15 + 5x Focus and it uses your AP and RP for actions.  You can channel your Transmuter abilities through the Proto Armatae, and Transmute Weapon can create a giant sized weapon for the Armatae to use.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead of the AP cost.

Only usable once.  You regain the use of this ability when you gain an Interlude Point.

 

Proto Armatae

HP: –

Evasion: 9/19

Guard: 4/14

 

Mini Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)

Cost: 0 AP

Range: 40ft

Description:  Fires a mini transmutation cannon of deconstructive energy making a light attack against a target.  Doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.

 

Humanoid Gripper (Left Arm)

Description: Humanoid Gripper can make all basic attacks. It is proficient in any transmuted weapon it holds. Its regular melee attacks deal physical damage and any transmuted weapon it wields gains the benefit of that weapon category.
You enter the Serene Water stance and gain an additional +17 bonus to your Evasion until the start of your next turn.

You may make a Heavy Attack against the target 3 times. On the first miss, the next attacks gain Lock On. On the second miss, the next attack gains Sure Hit. These only apply to attacks made during Tsubame Gaeshi.
The next Spell you cast this turn with an AP cost lower than 5 deals true damage.

You Gain Unholy Strength which grants +2 Power and Focus. While Unholy Strength is active your attacks/abilities that use your melee weapon to deal physical damage inflict Dark Damage instead and your Bone Armor will not break from damage. 

Upkeep: 1 Mana.

You may move up to your speed in a line. All enemies you pass through and all enemies within 15ft of your ending position take Light damage, become Challenged and Shaken until the start of your next turn.

You may sidestep to a target within range and make a Heavy attack against them. 

Then, until the end of the turn, you may Sidestep to any enemy you can see as part of a melee attack you are about to make. You gain Windflow stacks as if you spent AP on the movement equal to the AP spent on the attack.
You target one buff or passive effect you can identify from a grunt or heroic target within range. It is immediately removed and cannot be re-applied for the rest of the encounter.
Blesses the target, granting them the status of a church. Until the end of your next turn, the target gains Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types.

You enter the Whirling Death stance, spinning wildly and shooting at enemies within range. While in this Stance you may spend 2 AP to make a basic Light Attack with a pistol against all enemies within 20ft.

When you kill an enemy or make them enter the downed state from with this attack, you may repeat the attack.

The Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance or until you make an attack that is not tied to this ability.

You create a sudden snowstorm that obscures sight, creating difficult battle conditions. 

Attack accuracy for all affected units is reduced by your Focus and sight range is reduced to 60ft. A creature can only target something within their sight range.

You and creatures with Frost Immunity are not affected by this ability.

You may activate this ability as an Encounter Start action during the Encounter Start phase of an encounter. If you do, you do not pay the RP or initial mana cost.

Upkeep: You must pay 2 mana at the start of your turn or the effect ends at the end of that turn.

name: Secret Art: Within This Ink, The Perfect Answer

system.description:
You draw and immediately use a special talisman.

This talisman may have any spell in the base game on it (meaning it’s on the website), though it cannot be a secret or esoteric art. Any costs for this spell must be paid as normal. You must pay the required calligraphy units as if you made the spell yourself. If you can’t pay the required amount, you go into ‘debt’. While in debt, you cannot create any more talisman or use this ability.

To clear the debt, you must pay the required amount of calligraphy units at any point.

After you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of the arc.

You use a talisman you possess that contains a Secret Art. This functions like using a normal talisman. You may only use this once per encounter. Does not count towards your Secret Art usage for this encounter.
You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against the target. On damage, you may push the target 5ft in any direction.

For the next Spell you cast, you may choose to have it not affect a number of targets you can see equal to your Focus.

Only affects spells with an instantaneous effect (excluding setup things). Lingering spell effects such as Glittershards cannot be used with Selective Casting.

You touch an item not held or carried by another creature and immediately teleport it to your Dimensional Armory into an unoccupied space (if there is room).  If there is no space the spell fails.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory.  Living creatures cannot be teleported into the Dimensional Armory.

Overcharge: You spend 1 minute instead of 2 AP, reducing the mana cost by 1.

You can detect active magical effects that aren’t hidden within range.

Hidden magical effects may require a Perception or Insight check.
You make a Light attack against all enemies in range. On damage, you push the target back 5ft. If you landed a Killing Blow, all that took damage become Shaken as well.

You enter the Serene Water Stance. While in this Stance, you gain a +3 bonus to your evasion and you may move 5ft everytime an accuracy check against you misses. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance, you use the Block action or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this Stance.

You become like a shade becoming near weightless and gaining the ability to pass through spaces occupied by other creatures. You can also slip through small cracks in walls or doors, as long as they are at least 1inch wide and tall. Upkeep: You must pay 2 mana at the start of each turn or this ability ends. During the night, the mana cost and Upkeep of this is reduced by 2.

You cloak yourself in Shadows, giving you a +5 bonus on Stealth checks for 1 hour or until end of encounter. It also allows you to hide even when not behind cover or concealment. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

You prepare a powerful heavy attack against a single enemy. This attack deals extra damage based on half your missing health.

If that enemy provokes an AoO while you are charging this ability, you may immediately use this ability as if you finished charging it.
You may Teleport up to twice your movement speed. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

Your ally may treat their guard and block as if they were wearing your armor and shield until the end of the current creature’s turn. If multiple creatures of the same type move on the same initiative, it lasts through all of their turns.

Any temporary increases to the guard/block of this armor (such as through reinforce armor) is not transferred over. Any increases from armor plates or cloak are also not carried over. (But the target's own plates or cloak may apply.)

Benefit 1

The range of your darkvision increases by 60ft.

Benefit 2

You may use Darkvision.
system.benefits:
Benefit 1

The range of your darkvision increases by 60ft.

Benefit 2

You may use Darkvision.

system.description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may use your defenses instead of its own while within range. In addition, you may spend RP for it while dismounted if your mount is in range.
Every enemy within range must make a save against your Potency or take Light Damage. Any unattended objects made of glass or a similar vulnerable material also shatter.

For this encounter you may act during different parts of a round. When you end your turn with AP remaining, you may choose to act immediately after another creature ends their turn. You do not regain AP or RP and these extra actions are not considered turns. You may take these extra actions multiple times during a round, provided you have AP remaining.

You cannot use Setup abilities or abilities with the Active keyword during these extra actions.

You freeze the ground in a 20x20 area, creating difficult terrain that lasts until the end of your next turn.  You may use 1 mana per instance of this spell to continue the effect until the end of your next turn.

The attack targeting your VIP instead targets you. You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. You also gain the benefits of the Block action against the triggering attack.
system.requirement: Your VIP is the target of an attack.
